column8: Variant: living room with a low natural linen sofa and, at its right end, a wooden side table with a small clay lamp, on a handwoven rug. The right half of the frame shows a calm stretch of the painted wall and a tall window at the far right edge. The upper-left area of the painted wall is blank.

Variant: dining room with a solid parota table for four, woven chairs and a natural-fiber pendant over the table. The right half of the frame shows a low wooden sideboard with a clay pot. The upper-left area of the painted wall is blank.

The problem: rising damp with salt efflorescence (salitre) at the base of the wall: a white powdery crust and blistered, flaking paint up to about 60 cm above the floor, with a darker damp band above the baseboard. A wooden chair has been moved away from the wall.
Variant: two-storey house; the solid wooden front door, its steps and a small tree sit in the left half of the frame; the right half continues the facade with a black steel window.
